ازدلفتا (form VIII)
# اِزْدَلَفَتَا (izdalafatā) /iz.da.la.fa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِزْدَلَفَ (izdalafa)
# اُزْدُلِفَتَا (uzdulifatā) /uz.du.li.fa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِزْدَلَفَ (izdalafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
